flags: Website is a tourism listing (https://visithendersonvillenc.org/businesses/park-place-rv-park, which 403s to scripts); the operator's own site is http://www.parkplacervpark.com/ (the one Google Maps links). That site is stale: rates headed '2015 Daily Rate' ($30 up to 30 amp / $35 for 50 amp), pages last modified 2015-02-03, a dead 'extended.htm' (403) and a 'for sale' page for a 2000 Newmar.
No 2024+ rate from the operator anywhere; the only price indicator is RV Life's $$ tier. Asheville is 35 km away, so the US$50 gate would not apply anyway.

Long-stay check (weak): the site offers weekly and extended rates and mini-storage for 'extended stay customers ... while having your new home built', but also says 'We do not usually let people stay here to work' and posts a daily rate (2015). Nothing current shows whether it is mostly long-stay; Google's 3.6 stars from 79 reviews is low for the database.
